_note: Named-practitioner review, recorded batch by batch as it happens. Written by hand, deliberately: this is the one claim on the site no script can derive, and it must never extend to a page the reviewer has not read. Each entry's scope is exactly what was reviewed; the components render a credit only where a page matches one, and /reviewers/ states the remainder from the same data.
